name: Vine icon
description: UI slot for the vine. Composes `ss.proj.vine` through `use` so the slot shows the plant the weapon actually puts on the field rather than a second drawing of one that can drift from it — the same rule the dung slot it replaces was built on. The hole comes with it, and the hole is the weapon: this is the one thing in the arsenal that arrives from under the floor, and a picture of a leafy stem with no ground in it would be a picture of a plant. Tile is `$moss`, the stem's own green at full strength, which is the one ramp of it that holds clear of the Spit's bile and the Lash's husk. A ground line is pressed across the tile behind the plant so the hole reads as a hole rather than as a dark blot, and it sits low, because everything this weapon does happens at the player's feet.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin, derived rather than drawn again. It takes the plant's own evolved variant with it, so the slot shows the gilded wood the evolved weapon actually grows.
